# Edge cases

<!-- generated by catalog/kf_catalogo.py render from docs/catalogo.json: edit the JSON, not this file -->

Numbered catalogue of the ways a workflow run can stop half-way, fail or leave state inconsistent. Each case names the trigger, the expected behaviour (what state is kept and which command comes next), the child story that owns it and the test that covers it, or `por cobrir`. A case only counts as covered when its test exists and passes.

Measure with `kaizen catalog` (rc 0 only when EC coverage >= 0.9 and UC coverage >= 1.0); validate with `kaizen catalog --check`; after editing `docs/catalogo.json` run `kaizen catalog render`. Use cases: [use-cases.md](use-cases.md).

## Baseline

| Date | EC covered | EC fraction | UC covered | UC fraction |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-11-16 | 43/59 | 0.73 | 22/34 | 0.65 |

## Interruption (Ctrl+C, pane closed mid-phase)

| ID | Trigger | Expected | Owner | Test |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| EC-001 | Ctrl+C during a michi phase (DA step half done) | the last finished phase and step are journaled; `kaizen resume` continues from the next step | checkpoint-journal | `core/scripts/test_sp_journal.py::test_ec_001_inicio_sem_fim_e_interrompido` |
| EC-002 | Pane of a queued story closed while it was running | the watcher marks the story `falhou` and frees the slot; the next story in the queue starts | resume-orfaos | `core/scripts/test_sp_vigia.py::test_painel_morto_sem_estado_passa_a_falhou` |
| EC-003 | Ctrl+C while `sp-gates.py` is running a gate | the unfinished gate is not cached as green; rerunning the gates starts that gate again | testes-falha-90 | `core/scripts/test_sp_gates.py::test_ec_003_ctrl_c_num_gate_nao_o_deixa_verde_na_cache` |
| EC-004 | Interrupted while a story file is being rewritten (move, handoff, approval) | the write is atomic: the story is either the old or the new version, never truncated | checkpoint-journal | `core/scripts/test_sp_journal.py::test_ec_004_gravacao_atomica_leitor_nunca_ve_json_parcial` |
| EC-005 | Fresh session fails while printing the handoff it is consuming | the handoff file is kept; `handoff.py consume` can be run again | resume-orfaos | `core/scripts/test_handoff.py::test_consume_falha_a_imprimir_nao_apaga` |
| EC-006 | Ctrl+D (EOF) at a terminal confirmation | EOF counts as no; nothing is abandoned or deleted | preflight-erros-ux | `core/scripts/test_sp_fila_estado.py::test_obsoleta_eof_no_terminal_vale_como_nao` |
| EC-059 | `/sp-handoff --launch` run inside a pane started by a queue (`/clear`, then `/michi` in the same pane) | the handoff is allowed; the watcher keeps the story `a-correr` and does not mark it `falhou` or launch the next one | resume-orfaos | `core/scripts/test_sp_handoff.py::test_ec_059_retoma_num_painel_da_fila_repete_o_prompt_da_fila` |
| EC-069 | Terminal pane closed (SIGHUP) during a phase on Linux or macOS | the checkpoint is written with `interrompido: true` before the process ends (rc 128+SIGHUP) | testes-falha-90 | `core/scripts/test_falha_journal_disco.py::test_ec_069_sighup_num_processo_real_grava_checkpoint` |

## Crash (script, gate or test: rc != 0, exception, timeout)

| ID | Trigger | Expected | Owner | Test |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| EC-007 | A gate exits with rc != 0 | gates stop at the first red one and the table marks the rest as not run | testes-falha-90 | `core/scripts/test_sp_gates.py::test_run_para_no_primeiro_vermelho` |
| EC-008 | A gate hangs | the gate times out and counts as red with the timeout shown | testes-falha-90 | `core/scripts/test_sp_gates.py::test_run_timeout` |
| EC-009 | The test phase command hangs | timeout recorded as a failed attempt in the story | testes-falha-90 | `core/scripts/test_sp_gates.py::test_fase_testes_timeout` |
| EC-010 | An `sp-*` script raises an unexpected exception | the failure is appended to the local error log with script and type; rc != 0 | preflight-erros-ux | `core/scripts/test_kf_errlog.py::test_script_ligado_regista_erro_simulado` |
| EC-011 | The error log cannot be written (read-only or missing folder) | logging fails silently and the script keeps its own rc | preflight-erros-ux | `core/scripts/test_kf_errlog.py::test_falha_de_escrita_e_silenciosa` |
| EC-012 | A blocking workflow hook times out | the action is aborted before it changes anything | testes-falha-90 | `core/scripts/test_kaizen_hooks.py::test_timeout_bloqueante_aborta` |
| EC-013 | Unexpected error while the watcher handles one story | the other stories of the queue are still handled | testes-falha-90 | `core/scripts/test_sp_vigia.py::test_erro_inesperado_num_sp_nao_para_os_outros` |
| EC-014 | The same gate keeps failing | after `max_tentativas` the run stops and asks instead of looping | testes-falha-90 | `core/scripts/test_sp_gates.py::test_limite_de_tentativas_para` |
| EC-015 | A script module fails while being imported by another | the half-loaded module is not left registered; the next import retries cleanly | testes-falha-90 | `core/scripts/test_sp_carregar.py::test_erro_no_modulo_nao_deixa_nome_registado` |

## Quota, network, API and model session

| ID | Trigger | Expected | Owner | Test |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| EC-016 | Model quota or rate limit hit mid-phase | the story is left `bloqueado` with the cause; `kaizen resume` continues once the quota is back | preflight-erros-ux | `core/scripts/test_sp_vigia.py::test_quota_no_ecra_parado_bloqueia_com_motivo_e_retoma_em` |
| EC-017 | Network down during push or PR creation | the step is recorded as pending with the command to retry; nothing is marked done | preflight-erros-ux | `core/scripts/test_sp_resume.py::test_pausa_de_rede_usa_ec017` |
| EC-018 | A PR check errors on the hosting API | the check name and URL are shown | preflight-erros-ux | `core/scripts/test_pr_watch.py::Classify::test_erro_mostra_nome_e_url` |
| EC-019 | Model session or context runs out mid-phase | the phase is journaled before the handoff; the fresh session resumes from it | checkpoint-journal | `core/scripts/test_sp_journal.py::test_ec_019_fase_gravada_antes_do_handoff` |
| EC-020 | A session ends before done and the story allows escalation | the story is relaunched once at the next model level, in the same slot | resume-orfaos | `core/scripts/test_sp_vigia.py::test_decidir_uma_so_escalada` |
| EC-021 | The Enter sent to a new pane is lost and the prompt is not submitted | Enter is resent a bounded number of times, then the launch is marked as error | resume-orfaos | `core/scripts/test_handoff_spawn.py::test_enter_perdido_esgota_tentativas_e_fica_em_erro` |
| EC-022 | Author pane launched but the prompt never submits (`falhou`) after the ephemeral seed was deleted | the seed is kept until the session has read it, so the launch can be retried | resume-orfaos | `core/scripts/test_sp_autor_painel.py::test_ec_022_prompt_nao_submetido_mantem_a_semente_e_permite_relancar` |
| EC-066 | Model login or session expired (`/login`, OAuth token expired) | the story is left `bloqueado` with the cause and no automatic resume time; the message says to log in and run `kaizen resume` | preflight-erros-ux | `core/scripts/test_sp_vigia.py::test_sessao_expirada_bloqueia_sem_retoma_automatica` |

## Git and worktree (conflict, wrong branch, dirty or orphan)

| ID | Trigger | Expected | Owner | Test |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| EC-023 | PR merge hits a conflict | rc 12 and no merge; the conflict is reported | testes-falha-90 | `core/scripts/test_pr_fechar.py::test_conflito_rc12` |
| EC-024 | Watcher about to merge a story with red gates or a conflict | the story is blocked with the reason; no merge | testes-falha-90 | `core/scripts/test_sp_vigia.py::test_gates_vermelhos_ou_conflito_bloqueiam_com_motivo` |
| EC-025 | Story branch is behind the main branch | `sp-estado.py` warns and says to merge the main branch first | preflight-erros-ux | `core/scripts/test_sp_estado.py::test_avisa_ramo_atras_de_master` |
| EC-026 | Worktree to clean is still in use by a process | the clean is retried instead of leaving a half-removed worktree | resume-orfaos | `core/scripts/test_sp_vigia.py::test_clean_repete_enquanto_worktree_em_uso` |
| EC-027 | Story left in Doing with no live pane (orphan) | it is listed as a resume candidate | resume-orfaos | `core/scripts/test_sp_resume.py::test_candidatos_so_orfaos_fora_de_done_ec027` |
| EC-028 | Cleanup finds a dirty worktree | the worktree and its pane are never closed | resume-orfaos | `core/scripts/test_kf_term_limpar.py::test_planear_nunca_fecha_vivo_ativo_nem_worktree_suja_nem_proprio` |
| EC-029 | Leftover files in a finished worktree include a secret | the watcher refuses to commit them | testes-falha-90 | `core/scripts/test_sp_vigia.py::test_arrumar_worktree_recusa_segredos` |
| EC-030 | A stale copy of the story is left in TODO after it is closed | closing removes the copy | resume-orfaos | `core/scripts/test_sp_move.py::test_copia_em_todo_e_removida_ao_fechar` |
| EC-031 | Agent starts writing while the main checkout is not on the main branch | a preflight refuses and prints the command that fixes it | preflight-erros-ux | `core/scripts/test_sp_preflight.py::test_checkout_principal_fora_do_ramo_principal_ec031` |
| EC-060 | Story worktree has uncommitted changes when a run starts | the preflight lists the dirty files with EC-060 and proposes `git stash push -u -m <tag>`; nothing is changed without `--fix` and confirmation | preflight-erros-ux | `core/scripts/test_sp_preflight.py::test_arvore_suja_ec060_lista_ficheiros_sem_alterar` |
| EC-061 | Worktree is on a branch that is not `agent/<slug>` (or the story's branch) | the preflight reports the current and expected branch with EC-061 and proposes `git checkout <branch>` | preflight-erros-ux | `core/scripts/test_sp_preflight.py::test_ramo_errado_ec061` |
| EC-062 | The story's worktree is missing | the preflight reports EC-062 and proposes the command that creates it; no state is touched | preflight-erros-ux | `core/scripts/test_sp_preflight.py::test_worktree_em_falta_ec062` |
| EC-063 | A worktree is registered but its folder is gone (prunable) | the preflight reports EC-063 and proposes `git worktree prune`; never `worktree remove --force` | preflight-erros-ux | `core/scripts/test_sp_preflight.py::test_worktree_por_limpar_ec063` |
| EC-064 | A merge, rebase or cherry-pick is half done in the worktree | the preflight reports EC-064 and suggests `--continue`/`--abort` without running them | preflight-erros-ux | `core/scripts/test_sp_preflight.py::test_merge_a_meio_ec064_so_sugere` |

## Terminal crashed or machine off

| ID | Trigger | Expected | Owner | Test |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| EC-032 | Terminal crashed or machine off with panes still registered `a-correr` | registrations are reconciled with the live panes so orphans no longer take a slot | resume-orfaos | `core/scripts/test_sp_vigia.py::test_ec_032_paineis_orfaos_reconciliados_libertam_as_vagas` |
| EC-033 | Story left `pendente` for lack of a slot when a slot opens | the pending story starts on its own | resume-orfaos | `core/scripts/test_sp_fila_paralelo.py::test_ec_033_pendente_sem_vaga_arranca_quando_a_vaga_abre` |
| EC-034 | Session closed before the story reaches done | the story becomes `falhou` and the queue launches the next one | resume-orfaos | `core/scripts/test_sp_fila_paralelo.py::test_sessao_fechada_fora_de_done_vira_falhada_e_a_fila_lanca_a_seguinte` |
| EC-035 | The terminal GUI socket recorded for handoff is dead | the most recent live socket is used | resume-orfaos | `core/scripts/test_handoff_socket.py::test_live_socket_morto_escolhe_o_vivo_mais_recente` |
| EC-036 | No terminal multiplexer available for a parallel queue | refused with a clear error before any state is created | preflight-erros-ux | `core/scripts/test_sp_fila_paralelo.py::test_main_paralelo_sem_backend_recusa_antes_de_criar_estado` |
| EC-037 | Multiplexer times out when listing panes | a warning, and the list is shown with liveness unknown | preflight-erros-ux | `core/scripts/test_kf_term_ls.py::test_backend_timeout_avisa_e_lista` |
| EC-038 | Queue state left by a run that died (reboot) | the stale queue is refused and abandoning it is offered | resume-orfaos | `core/scripts/test_sp_fila_estado.py::test_fila_obsoleta_recusa_e_propoe_abandonar` |
| EC-039 | Watcher pid file left behind by a crash | stopping with a dead pid only deletes the file | resume-orfaos | `core/scripts/test_sp_vigia.py::test_parar_pid_morto_so_apaga` |
| EC-065 | `git` or Python is not on PATH | the preflight reports EC-065 with what is missing and how to install it; rc 1 | preflight-erros-ux | `core/scripts/test_sp_preflight.py::test_git_ausente_ec065` |
| EC-068 | Kaizen pieces missing from a project (skills, scripts, AGENTS.md block, hooks) | `kaizen doctor` reports them in one EC-068 message with rc 1 and proposes `kaizen doctor --fix`; nothing is overwritten | preflight-erros-ux | `tests/cli-hardening.test.js::doctor com peças em falta lista-as numa mensagem EC-068 e propõe --fix` |

## Concurrency and corrupted state

| ID | Trigger | Expected | Owner | Test |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| EC-040 | Two writers update the queue state at the same time | no record is lost | testes-falha-90 | `core/scripts/test_sp_fila_estado.py::test_dois_escritores_simultaneos_nao_perdem_registos` |
| EC-041 | Lock file held by a dead process | the lock is recovered | testes-falha-90 | `core/scripts/test_sp_disco.py::test_bloqueio_recupera_lock_de_dono_morto` |
| EC-042 | Lock file held by a live process | the lock is never stolen | testes-falha-90 | `core/scripts/test_sp_disco.py::test_bloqueio_nunca_apaga_lock_de_dono_vivo` |
| EC-043 | Two panes or agents start the same story | the second claim is refused | resume-orfaos | `core/scripts/test_sp_resume.py::test_segundo_painel_recebe_ec043_com_dono` |
| EC-044 | Two queues want the merge lock | one merges, the other waits for the next tick | testes-falha-90 | `core/scripts/test_sp_vigia.py::test_duas_filas_disputam_o_lock_de_merge` |
| EC-045 | Queue state JSON is corrupted | clear error and the file is not deleted | testes-falha-90 | `core/scripts/test_sp_fila_estado.py::test_estado_corrompido_da_erro_claro_e_nao_apaga` |
| EC-046 | Workflow hooks config is corrupted | the config is ignored and the action goes on | testes-falha-90 | `core/scripts/test_kaizen_hooks.py::test_config_corrompida_ignorada` |
| EC-047 | Pane state file is corrupted or its folder is missing | the pane hook never crashes the session | testes-falha-90 | `core/scripts/test_kf_painel_hook.py::test_raiz_inexistente_ou_json_corrompido_nao_rebenta` |
| EC-048 | `--seguinte` arrives while a story is still being launched | the same story is not launched twice | testes-falha-90 | `core/scripts/test_sp_fila_paralelo.py::test_seguinte_durante_o_lancamento_nao_relanca_o_mesmo_sp` |
| EC-049 | A second watcher is started for the same queue | it is refused | testes-falha-90 | `core/scripts/test_sp_vigia.py::test_cli_recusa_segundo_vigia` |
| EC-050 | Phase journal missing or corrupted at resume | resume falls back to the last valid entry and says which one | checkpoint-journal | `core/scripts/test_sp_journal.py::test_ec_050_linha_do_meio_invalida_vai_para_quarentena` |
| EC-067 | Invalid request to a kaizen command or to the queue state (unknown slug or folder, invalid transition or phase, wrong option) | refused without writing; the message (EC format) says what is valid and the next command | preflight-erros-ux | `core/scripts/test_sp_estado.py::test_recusas_do_estado_no_formato_ec` |
